character: Compact 3.6km California circuit famous for the Corkscrew — a blind, steep-drop chicane. 55m elevation change. Technical, with few straight-line braking zones. Rewards smooth, committed driving.
sources: https://www.tracktitan.io/post/laguna-seca-track-guide Corkscrew/Andretti Hairpin/Rainey Curve naming well documented

corners.name: Andretti Hairpin
corners.technique: Brake 150m before T2, straight line through T1 kink. Hit early first apex, drift out, tighten for second apex. Smooth throttle exit
corners.trap: Single apex approach loses exit speed onto the straight

corners.name: Turn 3
corners.technique: Brake 70m before, late apex for good exit speed

corners.name: Turn 4
corners.technique: Near-flat or light braking, commit to the speed, use full track width

corners.name: Turn 5
corners.technique: Trail brake into late apex, use the elevation change to help rotation
corners.trap: Under-rotating on the uphill and running wide

corners.name: Turn 6
corners.type: fast blind left with elevation change
corners.technique: Brake 50m before, commit to turn-in point. Use inside kerb to help rotation, early throttle up the Rahal Straight
corners.trap: Blind entry makes this scary — hesitation costs time up the straight

corners.name: Corkscrew
corners.technique: Brake ~100m before T7, hard and straight. Turn left, then as you crest the hill, flick right and drop. Commit on memory and feel — you can't see the apex
corners.trap: Everything about this corner is a trap — blind entry, massive elevation drop, left-right transition. Over-braking is most common; under-committing to the blind flick wastes time

corners.name: Rainey Curve
corners.technique: Carry speed from Corkscrew exit, smooth steering, use full track width on exit
corners.trap: Still recovering from Corkscrew and not committing to this fast corner

corners.name: Turn 10
corners.technique: Trail brake to late apex, good exit feeds T11 approach
corners.trap: Early apex compromises final corner entry

corners.name: Turn 11
corners.technique: Brake 90m before, hard and late. Smooth exit — feeds the start/finish straight. Most important corner for lap time
corners.trap: Lock-up on entry; early apex causes wheelspin on exit
